fact: Startup Arcube announced a USD 1.5 million (TND 4.7 million) funding round co-led by Tunis-based fund 216 CAPITAL with Fuel Ventures and Oxford Capital Partners.
The round was co-led by 216 CAPITAL, described as an investment fund based in Tunis and founded there in 2021, so a Tunisian financier is named in the USD 1.5 million round.
